description: The 'Content type' choice + 'Allow Generative Tools' checkbox shown in the UI resolve server-side to one of the workflows below, i.e. a (topaz_preset, denoise_tune) pair -- so the frontend never needs to know individual preset filenames. 'auto' defers the choice to the probe stage's content detector (app/content_detect.py), which picks one of the concrete types per file.

2d.label: 2D Graphics
2d._note: No generative variant for animation yet -- the checkbox makes no difference here.

_note_auto_fallback: Concrete type an Auto-Detect job is created with, and keeps if detection fails outright: Mixed (Film workflow) handles both live action and animation acceptably.
